summary: GH Research PLC filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $200 million of ordinary shares through Stifel as agent. No specific price per share, premium, or expected close date is stated; sales will be at prevailing market prices with a 3% commission. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. It represents ordinary capital-raising with no structural novelty or event-driven catalyst beyond the ATM program itself.
